_comment: EXAMPLES ONLY - copy this file to companies.json (git-ignored, personal) and replace the entries with the companies you want to watch. `slug` is the board identifier in the company's hosted careers URL: boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>, jobs.lever.co/<slug>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>, jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<slug>, apply.workable.com/<slug>. Boards move between vendors; a slug that stops working shows up in the search output's `errors` array.
